title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
abstract: arXiv:2611.03178v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decides actions, delegation, and acceptance, while the runtime maintains state and feedback. Its three-layer architecture enables direct execution or delegation to Subagents, synchronously or asynchronously, under stable responsibilities. translated_title: CoworkOS：面向真实世界自动化的智能体同事规模化扩展
translated_abstract: 协作智能体（cowork agents）的快速进展正在推动人机协作迈向真实世界的自动化，交付软件、设计等各类工作产物。然而，这类生产力工作既要求在复杂任务上实现高质量交付，又需要在长时程中持续进行监控与决策，二者的结合仍是尚未解决的开放性挑战。我们提出 CoworkOS，一个面向长时程工作的通用框架，它将任务策略与执行管理相分离：由模型负责决定行动、委派与验收，而运行时则负责维护状态与反馈。其三层架构能够在职责稳定的前提下，支持以同步或异步方式直接执行任务或委派给子智能体。通过共享的应用层，人类与智能体可以查看并修改同一份不断演进的文档、演示文稿、CAD 模型及 Blender 场景，从而使人在回路中的参与既能通过对话进入……
tldr: CoworkOS 是一个面向长时程智能体协作工作的通用框架，通过“任务策略与执行管理分离”的三层架构和人类与智能体共享编辑同一工作产物的应用层，实现了真实世界自动化中高质量交付与长时程监控决策的结合。
en_tdlr: CoworkOS is a general-purpose harness for long-horizon agent work that separates task strategy from execution management via a three-layer architecture, enabling humans and agents to co-edit the same evolving artifacts for high-quality real-world automation.
